patterns_discovered.description: Added exhaustive unit tests covering escape_html_attr, format_u64_commas, dur_label_precise, percentile_threshold, peak_parallelism, and cluster functions
Tests include empty arrays, single elements, zero values, negative inputs, and large numbers
Multiple tests verify XSS prevention through HTML escaping in tooltips and attributes
generate_html tests verify integration: empty dataset, summary table generation, tooltip escaping, heat color generation
Uses explicit Bar struct construction with all fields to create diverse test scenarios

gotchas_discovered.detail: escape_html_attr must handle all five special chars: &, <, >, ", and ' (as ')
dur_label_precise clamps negative values to 0 rather than erroring
percentile_threshold returns 0.0 for empty arrays, not error or None
Cluster function uses 30+ minute gaps to separate time groups
HTML generation must escape attribute values separately from element content to prevent XSS
